speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.description: O‘zingizni yozib oling va gapirish ishonchini oshiring.

A1.name: Beginner
A1.description: Start with basics: greetings, simple sentences, and everyday words.

A2.name: Elementary
A2.description: Build everyday communication for travel, shopping, and routines.

B1.name: Intermediate
B1.description: Express opinions, describe experiences, and handle most situations.

B2.name: Upper-Intermediate
B2.description: Discuss abstract topics and communicate fluently with native speakers.

C1.name: Advanced
C1.description: Use complex language flexibly for academic and professional goals.

C2.name: Proficiency
C2.description: Near-native mastery with precision, nuance, and stylistic control.
